description:
We are SixersGoToSpace, a team of 4 and our roster is full.

We are a team of NTU Computer Science, Computer and Aerospace Engineering students taking on the Flame in Freefall challenge. Our strengths are in software, coding, and web development, plus hardware and design. We will use data analysis, data visualization, and statistics to pull insights out of the microgravity combustion data, and apply artificial intelligence and machine learning to build the fire safety models.
